title: CPF Module Schema: Managed Redis Geo Replication Module
description: JSON schema for CPF module 'cpf-azure-prdsvc-managedredisgeoreplication'. Use this to generate Terraform code that calls the CPF module.

linked_managed_redis_ids.description: (Required) A set of other Managed Redis IDs to link together in the geo-replication group. The ID of the primary Managed Redis (managed_redis_id) is always included by default and does not need to be provided here. Requirements: - Can contain up to 4 Managed Redis IDs, making up a group of 5 in total (including the primary) - All Managed Redis must have the same geo_replication_group_name configured in their default_database block - All instances must be in different regions - All instances must use the same SKU - Once linked, the geo-replication state of all Managed Redis instances will be updated Example: [ "/subscriptions/{subscription-id}/resourceGroups/{rg-name}/providers/Microsoft.Cache/redisEnterprise/{redis-replica-1}", "/subscriptions/{subscription-id}/resourceGroups/{rg-name}/providers/Microsoft.Cache/redisEnterprise/{redis-replica-2}" ]

primary_managed_redis_id.description: (Required) The ID of the Managed Redis through which geo-replication group will be managed. Linking is reciprocal - if A is linked to B, both A and B will have the same linking state. There is no need to have duplicate azurerm_managed_redis_geo_replication resources for each instance. Changing this forces a new resource to be created. Example: "/subscriptions/{subscription-id}/resourceGroups/{rg-name}/providers/Microsoft.Cache/redisEnterprise/{redis-name}"

id.description: The Resource ID of the Managed Redis Geo-Replication.

name.description: The name of the Managed Redis Geo-Replication.

resource.description: The complete Managed Redis Geo-Replication resource.

agent_instructions.summary: To provision 'Managedredisgeoreplication' via Terraform, call this CPF module with the inputs defined below. Required inputs have no default and must be provided.
agent_instructions.module_type_notes: This is a single-service CPF module. It provisions one Azure resource type.
agent_instructions.naming_convention: Resource names are auto-generated by the module using app_id, environment, and region.
